items.label: Introduction
items.content:
# Introduction

**Essence:**
The AIClient library lets you generate AI text and images directly from your browser. No build step or module bundler required.

**Include the library:**
```html
<script src="https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/gh/HyperRushNet/hrn-ai/client/1.0.3.min.js"></script>
```

This script makes `client` globally accessible. Always include it **before any AIClient code**.

**Tips:**
- Only for browser usage, not Node.js.
- Works out-of-the-box, minimal setup.
- Keeps your project lightweight.

items.label: Initialize
items.content:
# Initialize

**Essence:**
You must authenticate with your unique API key before using AIClient.

**Code:**
```javascript
client.setApiKey('YOUR_API_KEY');
```

**Tips:**
- Store your API key securely.
- Only set once per session.
- All subsequent calls use this key.

items.label: Set Type
items.content:
# Step 1: Set Type

**Essence:**
For text generation, set the type to 'text'. This tells AIClient what kind of output to generate.

**Code:**
```javascript
client.setType('text');
```

**Tips:**
- Always set type before model or generate.
- 'text' is required for text generation functions.

items.label: Set Model
items.content:
# Step 2: Set Model

**Essence:**
Select the model you want to use for text generation. Models differ in speed, creativity, and cost.

**Code:**
```javascript
client.setModel('flux'); // default model
```

**Check available models:**
- [Models Page](https://enter.pollinations.ai/#:~:text=Models)
- [Model Health](https://model-monitor.pollinations.ai/)

**Tips:**
- Pick models suitable for your text type (story, assistant, code, etc.).

items.label: Generate
items.content:
# Step 3: Generate Text

**Essence:**
Send a prompt to the AI and get text output.

**Code:**
```javascript
const prompt = 'Write a motivational quote about AI.';
const output = await client.generate(prompt);
console.log(output);
```

**Tips:**
- Await the result for async behavior.
- Prompt quality strongly affects results.

items.label: Options
items.content:
# Step 4: Optional Functions

**Essence:**
Enhance text generation with system prompts, retry, and timeout options.

**Code:**
```javascript
client.setSystemPrompt('You are a helpful assistant.');
client.setTimeout(30000);
client.setRetry(true, 2, 1000);
```

**Tips:**
- System prompt sets the AI's persona.
- Timeout prevents long-hanging requests.
- Retry can help with intermittent network errors.

items.label: Set Type
items.content:
# Step 1: Set Type

**Essence:**
For image generation, set the type to 'image'.

**Code:**
```javascript
client.setType('image');
```

**Tips:**
- Always set type first.
- 'image' enables image output functions.

items.label: Set Model
items.content:
# Step 2: Set Model

**Essence:**
Choose the model for image generation. Some models specialize in photorealistic, stylized, or abstract outputs.

**Code:**
```javascript
client.setModel('flux');
```

**Check available models:**
- [Models Page](https://enter.pollinations.ai/#:~:text=Models)
- [Model Health](https://model-monitor.pollinations.ai/)

**Tips:**
- Select a model that fits your image style needs.

items.label: Generate
Options
items.content:
# Step 4: Optional Functions

**Essence:**
Set dimensions, retry, and other options to customize image output.

**Code:**
```javascript
client.setDimensions(1024, 1024);
client.setTimeout(30000);
client.setRetry(true, 2, 1000);
```

**Tips:**
- Dimensions affect resolution and processing time.
- Optional functions help you fine-tune results.
